hooks.name: entity_data_to
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no per-viewer entity data event; ProtocolLib's ENTITY_METADATA listener)

rust_summary: the entity data one player is sent, changeable for that viewer alone (`native_entity_data_to`), once a mod switched it on (`native_watch_entity_data`).
doc_summary: `native_entity_data_to(viewer, entity, values)` hears each `ClientboundSetEntityDataPacket` the server is about to send one player, its `(index, serializer, value)` entries changeable for that viewer alone (a glowing bit, a name only one player sees), just before `native_server_packet` hears the same packet. Nothing is decoded for it until a mod calls `native_watch_entity_data()`, and then only this packet. Bundles need "hooks": @API:entity_data_to@.
